# Callouts: Flash backup 10.2 - the cooker's main board wired for U7's cJTAG read

Source: Own photos, raptox's unit: stitched microscope mosaic of 2026-11-03 (~46 px/mm in this crop)  
Annotated image: [images/annotated/fb10-2_cooker-wiring.jpg](../../../images/annotated/fb10-2_cooker-wiring.jpg)

Supply through break-out A on J8. The reset hold from TP33 to GND at JP5 pin 2, on before power. Probe A on TP13 (TMSC) and probe B on TP14 (TCKC), wired to the LaunchPad's XDS110 (picture 10.3); the LaunchPad's GND on break-out A's header pin 30. No clip on U15, nothing else on the board. The U7 close-up is picture 10.1.
